excerpt: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source, MIT-licensed .NET library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel `.xlsx` workbooks, with no dependency on Microsoft Excel or any other native Office library. It exposes an Aspose.Cells-compatible API surface built around `Workbook`, `Worksheet`, `Cells`, and `Cell`. The library is pure managed code, multi-targeting `netstandard2.0` and `net8.0`, so the same package runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, including containerized and serverless environments.

excerpt: - **Load format scope.** Load support is limited to XLSX (`LoadFormat.Auto` and `LoadFormat.Xlsx`). Legacy XLS, ODS, CSV, and other spreadsheet formats are not loaded.

excerpt: - **Save format scope.** Save support currently covers XLSX and PDF (`SaveFormat.Xlsx` and `SaveFormat.Pdf`).

excerpt: - **No formula calculation engine.** `Cell.Formula` stores the formula as a string; the library does not parse, evaluate, or recalculate formulas.
- **No image or HTML export.** PDF export is supported, but there is no image or HTML rendering output in this checkout.

verification.evidence_note: Regenerated 2026-09-19: SaveFormat has only Xlsx and Pdf, so PDF is the sole non-XLSX output; no image or HTML output member exists.

excerpt: - **No print execution.** `Worksheet.PageSetup` configures how a spreadsheet application would print the file, but the library itself does not send workbooks to a printer.
- **No macros or VBA.** The public API has no VBA-project or macro-related types, so macro-enabled workbooks round-trip only their non-macro content.
- **No pivot tables.** Structured tables (`ListObject`) and charts (`Chart`) are supported; pivot tables are not part of the public API surface.
